These include a descendant of Jerahmeel (1 Chr 2:31), a chief of Judah (1 Chr 4:20), a leader of Simeon who led an expedition against the Amalekites at Mount Seir (1 Chr 4:42), and a chief of the half-tribe of Manasseh (1 Chr 5:24). The name's root in salvation (yasha) reflects a theophoric hope characteristic of Israelite naming practices."
